statement: Cycle–clique Ramsey numbers. Proves the Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp conjecture: $`R(C_m,K_n)=(m-1)(n-1)+1`$ for every $`m\ge n\ge3`$, except $`R(C_3,K_3)=6`$. This is the exact threshold forcing a red m-cycle or a blue n-clique in every red–blue coloring of a complete graph.
